verdict.rationale: dlt provides schema inference, incremental loading metadata, and pipeline observability via dltHub monitoring/MCP tools, and mentions 'lineage-aware pipeline runs' in orchestration docs, but there is no documented end-to-end lineage graph UI showing source-to-transformation-to-table dependencies. missing for 10: a dedicated lineage visualization/graph feature, column-level lineage tracking, and independent evidence that users can trace a table back through all transformation steps.
